requirements.description: Retrieve Microsoft's actual consolidated FY2024 total revenue as numeric records for the source-basis fiscal year beginning 2023-07-01 and ending 2024-06-30, using only the pre-cutoff 10-K source. Preserve reported USD units and source citations.

Obtain original Microsoft FY2024 Form 10-K income-statement table context showing Total revenue for the year ended June 30, 2024, together with the necessary reporting-unit caption (In millions, except per share amounts) and annual-column heading.

Obtain original Microsoft FY2024 Form 10-K text or table context establishing the fiscal-year period boundaries, preferably explicit disclosure of the fiscal year beginning July 1, 2023 and ending June 30, 2024; otherwise retain the shortest annual-report and income-statement headings that directly support FY2024 period boundaries.

reason: Plan evidence for Microsoft FY2024 consolidated total revenue, its reported unit, fiscal period boundaries, and original Form 10-K source provenance, restricted to material available on or before 2024-08-01. The prior review requested a corrected package with nonessential cover-page blocks trimmed, so separate numeric-query and targeted source-evidence requirements are used.
